title: Trump visit stirs Zambales fishers’ fears over US military presence
summary: Fisherfolk in Zambales province have reiterated their opposition to the proposed construction of a United States (US) ammunition factory in Subic Bay, warning that the project could pave the way for…

blocks.text: Fisherfolk in Zambales province have reiterated their opposition to the proposed construction of a United States (US) ammunition factory in Subic Bay, warning that the project could pave the way for the return of a US military presence in the area.
